title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Solo #13 (부채꼴 4구역·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her late 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a fierce, playful expression, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head, real pores, real living eyes, 50 clicker rings piercings set with pearls in copper-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of silver earrings. Full body painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 54% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 7 o'clock, 10 o'clock, 2 o'clock and 5 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is the wedge between the 7 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay), wide gold-and-silver bands following the contours of the body, with geometric star inlay filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 2 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, with geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 2 o'clock ray and the 5 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is the wedge between the 5 o'clock ray and the 7 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
